final: WITH counts AS (SELECT s.healtheval, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.zoneref) as site_count FROM scanconservation sc INNER JOIN sites s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY s.healtheval), shares AS (SELECT site_count, site_count * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(site_count) FROM counts) as share FROM counts), filtered AS (SELECT site_count, share FROM shares WHERE share > (SELECT AVG(share) FROM shares)) SELECT AVG(site_count) as avg_count, AVG(share) as avg_share, AVG(share - (SELECT AVG(share) FROM shares)) as avg_excess FROM filtered
